This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.

Project

ggpyramid is an R package that extends ggplot2 for building population pyramids (back-to-back bar charts of a population by age group and sex). It is Matan Hakim’s personal open-source package, public on GitHub at matanhakim/ggpyramid, with a pkgdown site at https://matanhakim.github.io/ggpyramid/. Sibling packages by the same author live next to it (../il.cbs.muni, ../rtlr) and set the house conventions for DESCRIPTION, pkgdown and CI; match them.

Status: skeleton only (Oct 2026). No exported functions yet and no API design has been agreed. Wait for Matan’s instructions before designing the interface (geom/stat ggproto objects vs. a wrapper function, input data shape, scales).

Commands

R is not on PATH in the Bash tool. Use the full path:

RS="/c/Program Files/R/R-4.5.2/bin/Rscript.exe"
"$RS" -e 'devtools::document()'          # regenerate man/ and NAMESPACE from roxygen
"$RS" -e 'devtools::test()'              # all tests
"$RS" -e 'devtools::test(filter = "package")'   # one file: tests/testthat/test-package.R
"$RS" -e 'devtools::check()'             # full R CMD check
"$RS" -e 'devtools::build_readme()'      # re-knit README.Rmd -> README.md
"$RS" -e 'pkgdown::build_site()'         # local site into docs/ (gitignored)
"$RS" -e 'lintr::lint_package()'

vdiffr (visual snapshot tests for plots) is not installed locally; install it and add it to Suggests before writing plot snapshot tests.

Conventions

  • Edit README.Rmd, never README.md; re-knit after changes and commit both.
  • NAMESPACE and man/ are generated by roxygen2 (markdown enabled); never hand-edit.
  • Call ggplot2 functions with ggplot2:: or add @importFrom in the roxygen block. R/ggpyramid-package.R holds package-level imports.
  • testthat edition 3. New code goes in R/<topic>.R with tests/testthat/test-<topic>.R.
  • Add every user-visible change to NEWS.md. While the only entry is “(development version)”, R CMD check reports a “No news entries found” NOTE; it is expected and disappears at the first numbered release.
  • .gitattributes forces LF line endings; CI runs on Linux, macOS and Windows.

CI and publishing

  • .github/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml (r-lib check-standard) runs on push/PR to main.
  • .github/workflows/pkgdown.yaml builds the site and deploys to the gh-pages branch, which GitHub Pages serves. Reference index layout goes in _pkgdown.yml.
  • The repo is public: everything committed is published.
